title: Arcis Blood Extraction and PCR Setup (Multi)
author: Opentrons
materials: Corning 360µL Plate, clean and empty Slot
Bioplastics Plate (in holder), clean and empty Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck and labware
steps.instruction: Place a clean, empty Corning 96‑well 360 µL flat plate in slot 1, a clean Bioplastics 100 µL plate in slot 2, another clean Bioplastics 100 µL plate in slot 3, and a USA Scientific 12‑channel reservoir in slot 4. Ensure the Opentrons P50‑Multi and P300‑Multi pipettes and 50 µL/300 µL tip racks are available.

steps.title: Load reagents into reservoir
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑channel reservoir as follows: Channel 1 with Reagent 1 (150 µL per sample, 15 mL for a full 96‑well plate); Channel 2 with Reagent 2 (20 µL per sample, 2 mL total); Channel 3 with MasterMix (20 µL per sample, 2 mL total); Channel 4 with Sample (30 µL per sample, 3 mL total).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons software, input the desired protocol parameters (e.g., number of samples, volumes) as required for the Arcis Blood Kit workflow.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol file from the Opentrons interface.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Configure deck map
steps.instruction: Verify that the deck layout in the OT App matches the physical arrangement described in Step 1.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and both the P50‑Multi and P300‑Multi pipettes according to the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the Arcis Blood extraction and PCR setup on the Opentrons robot.
